headline: Handcrafted in Florence, traced to the tannery
body: Reject fast fashion waste with a custom leather bag made to order in our Florentine workshop. See every step of our transparent supply chain before your piece is crafted.
rationale: This persona requires concrete proof rather than vague feelings. By directly citing the Florentine workshop and the traceable supply chain, we satisfy their demand for transparency and counter greenwashing skepticism while honoring their aversion to mass-market fast fashion.
